cohort: Women with previous single caesarean deliveries who underwent TOLAC between January 2016-December 2019 (n = 474).
finding: The success rate of VBAC after exclusion of caesarean cases due to maternal requests was 73.2%, with significant predictive value found in TOLAC score, BMI, number of previous VBACs and vaginal deliveries, birth weight, and BISHOP score at admission.
birth_weight: Recorded as part of the study
